entities.summary: Stac an Armin, based on the proper Scottish Gaelic spelling, is a sea stack in the St Kilda archipelago. It is 196 metres (643 ft) tall, qualifying it as a Marilyn. It is the highest sea stack in Scotland and the British Isles.
